# GenLeads

> GenLeads is an AI automation agency based in Kallakurichi, Tamil Nadu, India, serving businesses in India, the UAE and worldwide. We help business owners stop losing leads and stop doing repetitive work by hand.

## Services
- Speed to Lead: an AI agent replies to every WhatsApp, Instagram, email and website lead in under 60 seconds, qualifies it and books a call.
- Custom CRM: every lead, deal and customer tracked in one pipeline built for the business.
- Process Automation: invoices sent, payments collected and verified automatically.
- Reputation Management: review requests sent to every happy customer; unhappy feedback routed privately.
- Website Development: websites built with the whole lead system connected.

## Who we work with
Real estate, property management, resorts and hospitality, clinics, dental, salons and spas, software companies, restaurants, e-commerce, education, automotive, gyms and professional services.
